fields.label: Tag Reference
fields.options:
ALIGNMENT  (at start of line — sets alignment for the whole line)
[C] or [CENTER]   [R] or [RIGHT]   [L] or [LEFT]

TEXT STYLE  (inline — wrap around text)
[B]...[/B]   bold
[U]...[/U]   underline (single)
[UU]...[/UU]   underline (double)
[INV]...[/INV]   inverted — white text on black background
[FLIP]...[/FLIP]   upside-down text
[FB]...[/FB]   Font B (smaller / narrower)

SIZE  (inline — can combine with style tags)
[BIG]...[/BIG]   2× width + 2× height, auto bold
[W2]...[/W2]   double width only
[H2]...[/H2]   double height only
[W:n]...[/W:n]   width multiplier n = 1–8
[H:n]...[/H:n]   height multiplier n = 1–8

SEPARATORS
[LINE]   full-width dashed line ( - - - )
[DLINE]   full-width double line ( === )
[RULE:char]   full-width line with custom char   e.g. [RULE:*] or [RULE:=]

CONTROLS
[CUT]   full paper cut
[PCUT]   partial cut
[FEED]   feed 1 blank line
[FEED:n]   feed n blank lines
[DRAWER]   open cash drawer pulse

BARCODES & QR
[BARCODE:value:TYPE]   e.g. [BARCODE:{{ doc.name }}:CODE39]
[BARCODE:value:TYPE:height]   barcode with height in dots e.g. :80
[QR:value]   QR code (default size 6)
[QR:value:size]   QR code with explicit size 1–16
Types: CODE39   EAN13   EAN8   UPC-A   ITF   NW7

RAW ESC/POS
[HEX:bytes]   emit raw bytes as hex string   e.g. [HEX:1B40] = ESC @

JINJA NOTES
• Use {{ doc['items'] }} (bracket notation) for child tables — doc.items conflicts with Python dict method
• Use {{ doc.field_name }} for regular fields
• All standard Jinja2 syntax works: loops, conditions, filters, macros
• Use {%- -%} to suppress blank lines around control blocks

COMBINING TAGS (any combination is valid on one line)
[C][BIG]HEADER[/BIG]
[C][B][INV] NOTICE [/INV][/B]
[R][FB]small right text[/FB]
[R][B][U]{{ '%.2f'|format(doc.grand_total) }}[/U][/B]
